entities.name: Maurice Lévy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maurice Lévy is a French-Moroccan businessman. Since 1984, he has served as Chairman of the Supervisory Board of Publicis Groupe, the world's third largest advertising and communications group. Founded in 1926, Publicis Groupe counts today over 80,000 employees and is present in over 100 countries around the world.
